They llook and are really sturdy, exactly like the more expensive profi ones. The most I like is that is "in one piece" not with an attached bottom, which is a huge advantage for consistent heating. My first steak got an amazing browning.

Normally, an all clad guy, I really like these pans. Much easier to flip stuff with one hand, and although slightly thinner than the all clad, heat distribution is fast and even. Handles are hefty (almost too big) and rivets seem solid. Should be great pans for a long time. They are oversized for what the spec says and the side walls are much higher than the all clad pans.. (The 8 inch one is closer to a 10 inch all clad pan, as an example.) My only complaint is that they are not sold separately because I would like four or five of the 8 inch.
Great pans and great price, these are used every day and never fail, worth every cent, as good as the top end stuff that’s on the market, would buy again
Pans heat evenly and when warmed correctly food does not stick. The pans have good weight and feel solidly constructed. Definitely recommend these pans at the given price.
Pour le prix je suis tres satisfais. Une poêle n'es pas complètement a plat (10") mais très subtilement. Bien content de mon achat. Dégelé mon chili pour mes " chilie dog" très bien. Poigné solide.
Decent enough to cook with however after 3 times cooking with it. It’s hard to remove the burn marks and that’s even low heat with greasing the pan.

we picked this up for use with our mach e. in South louisiana the mosquitoes are terrible, and this provided us a safe haven from them. we put an air mattress in the tent for our teenager. me and my wife had a bed made up in the back of the mach e and its AC kept us all comfortable this labor day weekend in breau bridge louisiana.

Se Stanem jsme dali 14-dní po Evropě a musím uznat, že za ty prachy je to Skvělé. Dokonce přečkal i jenu neskutečnou bouři, kdy ač dáme hodně, tak jsme raději seděli v autě a čekali jestli neuletí. Je potřeba koupit pod stan obyčejnou 200g/m2 plachtu, podlážka je slabá a bál bych se hodně o roztržení.

Very high-quality construction, solid, made entirely of iron, large pipe; everything functions as described—water from the vertical pipe drains out through the valve. Now we’re just waiting for winter.

I used 25 of these bags for a weeklong summer day camp. The kids put the bags through the ringer, but none if them ever ripped or broke. The kids did untie a few of them and dump out the sand, but the bags themselves held up the entire time.
